battle.name: 鉑金戰爭
battle.theater: 拉普拉塔河與烏拉圭河流域
battle.brief: 一八五一年八月起，巴西帝國聯同烏拉圭政府與阿根廷恩特雷里奧斯、科連特斯三省結盟，沿拉普拉塔河水系向布宜諾斯艾利斯推進；二月三日卡塞羅斯一役，聯軍以四十五門砲對羅薩斯六十門砲，兩翼崩潰，羅薩斯出逃。線膛野戰砲在歐洲剛剛定型，兩軍用的仍是滑膛砲，是滑膛野戰砲最後一次大規模上陣。

kit.name: 線膛砲
kit.history: 線膛讓同樣的藥量走得更遠。砲兵第一次可以在射程上贏步兵。

countries: 交戰分兩大陣營。聯軍一方是巴西帝國、烏拉圭的國防政府，以及阿根廷的恩特雷里奧斯、科連特斯與聖菲三省。巴西以常備軍承擔主力：帝國陸軍四個師編制，砲兵營、騎兵與工兵齊備，一八五一年九月由卡希亞斯公爵率一萬六千二百人越境進入烏拉圭；海軍由英籍的約翰・帕斯科・格倫菲爾上將執掌，率巡防艦、巡洋艦、雙桅縱帆船與汽船混編的艦隊，控制拉普拉塔河口與巴拉那河上游水道。烏拉圭方面是設於蒙得維的亞的國防政府，由歐赫尼奧・加爾松統率，一八五一年十二月其人病逝後由何塞・米格爾・加蘭接手，烏拉圭旅直接編入聯軍序列。阿根廷方面由恩特雷里奧斯總督胡斯托・何塞・德・烏爾基薩任全軍統帥，恩特雷里奧斯、科連特斯與聖菲的省級民兵編為主力，原屬邦聯的單一主義者如巴托洛梅・米特雷、多明哥・法烏斯蒂諾・薩爾門托以志願身份加入；聯軍各師旅長組成戰爭會議，聯軍內部各指揮部自主作戰，不設統一的戰術指揮。對面是阿根廷邦聯，名義上由聯邦條約維持，實權集中於布宜諾斯艾利斯省總督胡安・曼努埃爾・德・羅薩斯手中，其軍隊以省級民兵、鄉土游擊隊與雇傭槍手組成，由羅薩斯直接統率；另一方是駐在烏拉圭的「塞里托政府」，即白黨首腦曼努埃爾・奧里貝的殘部。巴拉圭以卡洛斯・安東尼奧・洛佩斯為首，在一八五〇年十二月的防禦同盟中站在巴西一方，供應馬匹與物資，但至戰役末段仍拒絕派兵加入，維持自守。
countriesEn: The war was fought between two camps. On the allied side stood the Empire of Brazil, the Uruguayan Defence Government seated in Montevideo, and three Argentine provinces: Entre Ríos, Corrientes and Santa Fe. Brazil supplied the weight of the allied side with its standing army, organised in four divisions with artillery companies, cavalry and engineers, of which 16,200 men under the Duke of Caxias crossed into Uruguay in September 1851. Its navy was commanded by a British officer, Rear Admiral John Pascoe Grenfell, whose mixed squadron of frigate, corvettes, brigs and steamships held the mouth of the Plata and the upper Paraná. The Montevideo Defence Government was led by Eugenio Garzón, who died of illness in December 1851 and was replaced by José Miguel Galán; the Uruguayan brigade was folded directly into the allied order of battle. On the Argentine side the whole allied army was commanded by Justo José de Urquiza, governor of Entre Ríos; the provincial militias of Entre Ríos, Corrientes and Santa Fe formed its core, while former Confederation Unitarians such as Bartolomé Mitre and Domingo Faustino Sarmiento joined as volunteers. The allied command was a war council of division commanders, and each formation fought its own way without any single tactical director. Opposite them stood the Argentine Confederation, nominally held together by the federal pact but in fact ruled by Juan Manuel de Rosas, governor of Buenos Aires, whose army of provincial militias, rural montoneras and hired gunmen he commanded in person. The other allied-by-coincidence party was the Cerrito Government in Uruguay, the remnant of the Blanco leader Manuel Oribe. Paraguay, under Carlos Antonio López, stood on the Brazilian side of the defensive alliance signed in December 1850 and supplied horses and stores, yet refused to commit troops to the final phase of the war and remained on the defensive.
people: 關鍵人物是胡斯托・何塞・德・烏爾基薩。他本是羅薩斯麾下最有力的軍頭之一，一八五一年五月一日以恩特雷里奧斯省的名義宣布收回本省被委託給布宜諾斯艾利斯的主權，隨後發表宣言要求羅薩斯辭職，並接受巴西的貸款與後勤支援，率領自稱「大軍」的聯軍東征。他用兵大膽卻獨斷，聯軍各師長在卡塞羅斯戰前召開戰爭會議後各自指揮自己的部隊，烏爾基薩本人按兵觀望，直到兩翼開始崩潰才投入騎兵衝鋒。對面的胡安・曼努埃爾・德・羅薩斯是邦聯的實權人物，他選在卡塞羅斯高地佈防，卻沒有派人偵察地形，戰至白熱化時喬裝水手離開戰場，經英國公使羅伯特・戈爾登上英國船「半人馬座號」流亡英國，二十年後才回國。巴西方面，元帥路易斯・阿爾維斯・德・利馬・西爾瓦（卡希亞斯公爵）率主力師團策應正面，曼努埃爾・馬爾克斯・德・索薩（波多阿雷格侯爵）率第一師與烏拉圭部隊同行，曼努埃爾・路易斯・奧索里奧（埃瓦爾侯爵）領先鋒，戴維・卡納巴羅與何塞・費爾南德斯分率第三、第四師；海軍由英籍的約翰・帕斯科・格倫菲爾上將指揮，一八五一年十二月十七日強行通過托內萊羅水道。羅薩斯陣中，砲兵指揮官馬丁尼亞諾・奇拉韋特在中央陣地以砲火支撐到底；安赫爾・帕切科、赫拉西莫・科斯塔與伊拉里奧・拉戈斯分領各翼。烏拉圭方面，曼努埃爾・奧里貝被合圍後於一八五一年十月十九日無力投降；被圍在布宜諾斯艾利斯城內的瓦倫廷・阿爾西納與曼努埃爾・德・伊里戈延堅守到城破，前者重傷不治，後者自盡。
peopleEn: The central figure was Justo José de Urquiza. He had been one of the most powerful military leaders under Rosas, and on 1 May 1851 he declared in the name of Entre Ríos that the province resumed the full exercise of its own sovereignty, which had been delegated to the governor of Buenos Aires; he followed with a pronunciamiento demanding Rosas's resignation, accepted Brazilian loans and logistic support, and led the allied Grand Army east. He was bold but autocratic: at Caseros the allied division commanders met in a war council and then fought each their own battle, while Urquiza himself held his cavalry back until the enemy flanks began to collapse, and only then charged. His opposite number, Juan Manuel de Rosas, was the real power of the Confederation. He chose the heights of Caseros for his position, but sent nobody to reconnoitre the ground, and when the battle reached its crisis he left the field disguised as a sailor and, through the British consul Robert Gore, boarded the British ship Centaur for exile in the United Kingdom, returning to his country only twenty years later. On the Brazilian side, the marshal Luís Alves de Lima e Silva, Duke of Caxias, led the main divisions in support of the front; Manuel Marques de Sousa, Marquis of Porto Alegre, marched with the first division and the Uruguayans; Manuel Luís Osório, Marquis of Herval, led the vanguard; David Canabarro and José Fernandes commanded the third and fourth divisions. At sea, the British-born Rear Admiral John Pascoe Grenfell commanded the squadron and forced the Passage of the Tonelero on 17 December 1851. On Rosas's side the artillery commander Martiniano Chilavert held the centre with his guns until the end; Ángel Pacheco, Jerónimo Costa and Hilario Lagos led the wings. In Uruguay, Manuel Oribe, encircled and unable to fight, surrendered on 19 October 1851. Inside the besieged city of Buenos Aires, Valentín Alsina and Manuel de Irigoyen held out until it fell: the first died of his wounds, the second took his own life.
kits: 本卡所列的一八五〇年型線膛前裝野戰砲屬普魯士系的新式野戰砲，整條膛線讓火藥推出的彈丸旋轉起來，使同樣裝藥走得更遠、落點更集中，砲兵第一次可以在射程上壓過步槍。但這件兵器在一八五一年只剛剛定型，拉普拉塔河兩岸的砲兵手上並沒有它：真正上陣的仍是滑膛砲，青銅砲身，口徑四磅、六磅、八磅，配十二磅曲射砲，另有相當數量的舊式攻城重砲與固定砲位。卡塞羅斯一役，聯軍火炮四十五門、羅薩斯六十門；托內萊羅水道一線，阿根廷守軍佈置十六門砲；卡希亞斯師團入烏拉圭時只配二十六門砲。火箭是這一時期的另一件利器，聯軍在卡塞羅斯配有一至兩門康格里夫火箭砲連，羅薩斯也有一門。步兵以火繩與雷管前裝步槍為主，巴西軍隊逐步改用雷管，阿根廷民兵仍大量使用火繩；巴西騎兵配馬刀與長矛，阿根廷與烏拉圭的高陶索騎兵用馬刀與短槍。馬匹是真正的瓶頸：一萬六千餘匹戰馬由巴拉圭供應，每門野戰砲另需四至六匹拉砲馬，補充靠佔領區徵收與內陸牛車運送。攻城與運輸方面，巴西海軍一八五一年共有五十九艘船，包括三十六艘武裝帆船與十艘武裝汽船，聯軍就是靠這些船把步兵與砲兵沿烏拉圭河、巴拉那河運到瓜萊瓜伊楚，再以徒步與牛車深入內陸；攻城方沒有大型攻城器械，圍城主要靠封鎖、壕溝與砲壘。
kitsEn: The piece shown on this card is an 1850-pattern rifled muzzle-loading field gun of Prussian type. The whole length of rifling put the shot into a spin, so the same charge of powder carried further and fell more truly on the mark, and for the first time the gunner could outrange the infantryman. But in 1851 the type had only just been settled, and the gunners on both banks of the Plata did not have it: what actually went into action were smoothbore guns, bronze, of four, six and eight pounds, with twelve-pounder howitzers, plus a good number of old siege pieces and fixed emplacements. At Caseros the allies had forty-five guns against Rosas's sixty; along the Tonelero the Argentine defenders emplaced sixteen pieces; the division that Caxias took into Uruguay carried only twenty-six. Rockets were the other weapon of the moment: the allies fielded one or two Congreve rocket batteries at Caseros, and Rosas had one. Infantry were armed mainly with flint and percussion muzzle-loading muskets, the Brazilian army converting steadily to percussion while the Argentine militias kept large numbers of flintlocks; Brazilian cavalry carried sabres and lances, while the Argentine and Uruguayan gaucho horsemen used sabres and short carbines. Horses were the true bottleneck: more than sixteen thousand mounts were supplied by Paraguay, every field gun needed another four to six draught animals, and remounts were drawn from occupied districts and hauled inland by ox cart. For siege and transport, the Brazilian navy counted fifty-nine vessels in 1851, among them thirty-six armed sailing ships and ten armed steamships; it was these ships that carried the infantry and guns up the Uruguay and the Paraná to Gualeguaychú, and from there the armies went forward on foot and by ox cart. The besiegers had no heavy siege train: the blockade, the trench and the battery emplacement did the work of a siege.
tactics: 聯軍的方案是海陸兩路齊進。海路由卡希亞斯率大約一萬二千人留在烏拉圭的科洛尼亞・德爾・薩克拉門托，計畫在布宜諾斯艾利斯港登陸；陸路則把步兵與砲兵裝上巴西軍艦，沿海拉普拉塔河與烏拉圭河北上。一八五一年十二月十七日，格倫菲爾率四艘汽船、三艘巡洋艦與一艘雙桅縱帆船強行通過巴拉那河上的托內萊羅水道，岸上盧西奧・諾貝托・曼西拉以十六門砲與兩千名步槍手構成的防線攔不住，次日巴西艦隊再闖一次，曼西拉誤以為敵軍要從背後登陸，拋下砲位撤退。聯軍在瓜萊瓜伊楚集結：烏爾基薩的騎兵從蒙得維的亞走陸路，烏拉圭部隊由海路運到波特雷羅・佩雷斯再徒步前進，十二月三十日全軍在迪亞曼特會合，隨後橫渡巴拉那河到聖菲。此後聯軍以「南方大軍」名義沿鹽河一線的鄉間道路與車轍南下，後隊與兩翼由騎兵遮蔽，火炮集中使用而不鋪開成排，砲兵營緊隨先頭步兵推進，補給靠河船與徵集。接近布宜諾斯艾利斯時先鋒接連作戰：一月二十九日阿爾瓦雷斯草原一役擊退安赫爾・帕切科派來的四千人，三十一日再於馬爾克斯橋擊敗其主力，二月一日先鋒已距城不到九公里。二月三日卡塞羅斯開戰，羅薩斯據卡塞羅斯高地居高臨下，聯軍自莫龍溪的低地展開，烏爾基薩以騎兵直衝羅薩斯左翼，巴西步兵在烏拉圭旅與一個阿根廷騎兵中隊配合下攻下右翼的帕洛馬爾圓形建築；兩翼既失，中央便只剩奇拉韋特的砲兵與聯軍對射，奇拉韋特命人撿回戰場上散落的彈藥繼續抵抗，彈藥耗盡之後巴西兵才占領山頭，戰局才定。海軍則以封鎖代替攻城：河口與上游水道盡在聯軍掌握，城內糧食、火藥與援軍被切斷。
tacticsEn: The allies planned to advance on two axes at once. On the sea, Caxias held some twelve thousand men at Colonia del Sacramento in Uruguay with the intention of landing them in the port of Buenos Aires. On the land, the infantry and the guns were loaded aboard Brazilian warships and carried north up the Plata and the Uruguay. On 17 December 1851 Grenfell forced the Passage of the Tonelero with four steamships, three corvettes and a brig, passing the Argentine line held by Lucio Norberto Mansilla with sixteen pieces and two thousand riflemen, who could not stop them; the next day the squadron broke through again, and Mansilla, wrongly believing the enemy meant to land behind him, abandoned his guns and withdrew. The allies concentrated at Gualeguaychú: Urquiza's cavalry came overland from Montevideo, the Uruguayans were carried by sea to Potrero Pérez and walked the rest, and on 30 December the whole force met at Diamante before ferrying across the Paraná to Santa Fe. Thence the army marched south under the name of the Grand Army of the South, along the country roads and cart ruts of the Salado, its rear and flanks screened by cavalry, its guns kept concentrated instead of spread out, the artillery companies following close behind the leading infantry, and its supply carried by river vessels and requisition. As it closed on Buenos Aires the vanguard fought in turn: the field of Alvarez on 29 January turned back the four thousand men Ángel Pacheco had sent, the bridge of Marqués Bridge on the 31st beat his main force, and by 1 February the outposts stood less than nine kilometres from the city. Caseros was fought on 3 February. Rosas held the heights of Caseros and looked down on the field, while the allies deployed out of the low ground of the Morón creek: Urquiza charged the Rosista left with cavalry, the Brazilian infantry, a Uruguayan brigade and an Argentine cavalry squadron took the round building called the Palomar on the right, and once both flanks were gone the centre was reduced to Chilavert's guns trading fire with the allies. Chilavert had his men pick up the ammunition scattered over the field and kept firing; only when it was spent did the Brazilians climb the hill and the battle was decided. At sea the blockade did the work that a siege train would have done: the river mouth and the upper channels were in allied hands, and the city's food, powder and reinforcements were cut off.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。聯軍總兵力方面，巴西出兵二萬零二百人，阿根廷反叛軍二萬人，烏拉圭軍二千人；對面阿根廷邦聯二萬六千人，白黨八千五百人。卡希亞斯一八五一年九月四日越過南大河州邊界時，帶一萬六千二百人，其中步兵六千五百、騎兵八千九百、砲兵八百、火砲二十六門，尚不足巴西陸軍三萬七千人的一半，另有四千人留守邊境。海軍方面，格倫菲爾的混編分隊有一艘巡防艦、七艘巡洋艦、三艘雙桅縱帆船與六艘汽船，巴西海軍一八五一年共有五十九艘船。戰前奧里貝的八千五百人被約一萬五千人包圍，於十月十九日投降。托內萊羅一線，阿根廷守軍十六門砲、兩千名步槍手，聯軍出動八艘船。卡塞羅斯一役，聯軍二十六千人（阿根廷二萬、烏拉圭二千、巴西四千）、四十五門砲，內含騎兵一萬六千、步兵九千、砲兵一千；羅薩斯方同樣二萬六千人，騎兵一萬五千、步兵一萬、砲兵一千，六十門砲。交戰歷時約六小時；官方報告聯軍六百人死傷（陣亡三百、受傷三百），羅薩斯方一千四百人死傷、七千人被俘；另有統計稱全場傷亡約二千人，僅佔參戰人數約百分之四。全戰役的傷亡，參考戰史著作的估計為聯軍六千五百以上、羅薩斯方一萬一千以上。距離與時間上，聯軍自烏拉圭河口到卡塞羅斯縱走六百餘公里，烏爾基薩在開戰宣言中說，自渡過迪亞曼特水道的急流到那一天只過了四十天。兵種比例上，聯軍平均每五百餘人配一門砲，二月一日先鋒距城約九公里。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. On the allied side the Empire of Brazil put 20,200 men into the field, the Argentine rebels 20,000 and the Uruguayans 2,000; against them the Argentine Confederation had 26,000 and the Blancos 8,500. When Caxias crossed the border from Rio Grande do Sul on 4 September 1851 he took 16,200 men, of whom 6,500 were infantry, 8,900 cavalry and 800 artillerymen with twenty-six guns, less than half of the Brazilian army of 37,000, while another 4,000 stayed behind to guard the border. At sea, Grenfell's mixed squadron comprised one frigate, seven corvettes, three brigs and six steamships, and the Brazilian navy counted fifty-nine vessels of every type in 1851. Before the campaign Oribe's 8,500 men, encircled by roughly 15,000, surrendered on 19 October. At the Tonelero the Argentine line had sixteen pieces and two thousand riflemen, and the allies brought eight ships against them. At Caseros the allies fielded 26,000 men (20,000 Argentine, 2,000 Uruguayan, 4,000 Brazilian) with forty-five guns, made up of 16,000 cavalry, 9,000 infantry and 1,000 artillerymen; Rosas had the same 26,000 men with 15,000 cavalry, 10,000 infantry and 1,000 artillerymen, and sixty guns. The fighting lasted about six hours. The official report gives 600 dead and wounded on the allied side (300 killed, 300 wounded) and 1,400 killed or wounded with 7,000 captured on the Rosista side; another reckoning puts the whole cost at about 2,000 casualties, only some four per cent of the men who fought. For the war as a whole, the campaign histories estimate more than 6,500 dead and wounded on the allied side and more than 11,000 on Rosas's. In distance and time: the allies covered more than six hundred kilometres inland from the mouth of the Uruguay to Caseros, and Urquiza told his troops in the proclamation of the battle that only forty days had passed since the crossing of the rapids of the Paraná at the Diamante channel. In terms of arm, the allies averaged a little over five hundred men to a gun, and on 1 February the vanguard was about nine kilometres from the city.
cause: 打起嚟有六層原因。第一，羅薩斯在阿根廷邦聯推行二十年的鐵腕政策，並企圖以布宜諾斯艾利斯為中心重建一八二五年廢除的拉普拉塔總督區，把玻利維亞、烏拉圭、巴拉圭重新併入，把南大河州的土地也劃入版圖；巴西帝國視之為南部邊疆與馬托格羅索通航的存亡之爭，一旦拉普拉塔水系落入敵手，巴西縱深與里約熱內盧之間的交通就要靠耗時數月、冒險穿越內陸的陸路維持。第二，英法自一八四五年起封鎖拉普拉塔河，一八五〇年《阿拉納—南部條約》解除封鎖後，羅薩斯立刻禁止一切對蒙得維的亞的貿易，恩特雷里奧斯的港口因蕭條，烏爾基薩與羅薩斯的裂痕由此公開。第三，烏拉圭的白黨與紅黨內戰打了近十年，奧里貝的軍隊長期包圍蒙得維的艾亞，巴西擔心這座城市落入羅薩斯控制，於是支持紅黨的國防政府。第四，烏爾基薩與巴西互相利用：巴西貸款給恩特雷里奧斯與科連特斯，二省在一八五一年五月一日宣布收回自己的主權，要求羅薩斯下台。第五，巴西有步驟地布局，一八五一年三月十六日公開承認並支援烏拉圭國防政府，二月二十五日與巴拉圭簽訂防禦同盟取得馬匹，五月二十九日與烏拉圭、恩特雷里奧斯、科連特斯組成進攻同盟，八月二日首批分遣隊在烏拉圭登陸守住塞羅堡。第六，羅薩斯不願坐困，八月十八日先向巴西宣戰，戰爭就此全面展開。戰爭因拉普拉塔河的「plata」（銀）得名，西語稱 Guerra Platina、葡語稱 Guerra do Prata，中文譯作「鉑金戰爭」；同一地名在一九〇六至一九〇九年的阿根廷與巴西仲裁危機中被再次沿用。
causeEn: Six causes lay behind the fighting. First, Rosas had ruled the Argentine Confederation with an iron hand for twenty years and wanted to rebuild the Viceroyalty of the Río de la Plata, abolished in 1825, with Buenos Aires at its centre, annexing Bolivia, Uruguay and Paraguay and taking in the lands of Rio Grande do Sul; the Empire of Brazil read this as a struggle for survival on its southern frontier and for the navigation of Mato Grosso, since a hostile hand on the Plata waterways would force the route between the Brazilian interior and Rio de Janeiro into a land road of many weeks through hostile country. Second, Britain and France had blockaded the Plata from 1845, and when the Arana–Southern Treaty lifted the blockade in 1850 Rosas immediately forbade all trade with Montevideo; Entre Ríos ports went quiet, and the breach between Urquiza and Rosas became public. Third, nearly ten years of civil war between the Blancos and the Colorados of Uruguay had left Oribe's army besieging Montevideo, and Brazil, afraid that the city would fall to Rosas, backed the Colorado Defence Government. Fourth, Urquiza and Brazil used each other: Brazil lent money to Entre Ríos and Corrientes, and on 1 May 1851 the two provinces declared their sovereignty restored and demanded that Rosas resign. Fifth, Brazil laid its preparations out step by step: on 16 March 1851 it openly recognised and supported the Uruguayan Defence Government; on 25 December it signed a defensive alliance with Paraguay that brought in horses; on 29 May it formed the offensive alliance with Uruguay, Entre Ríos and Corrientes; and on 2 August the first detachments landed in Uruguay to hold the Cerro fort. Sixth, Rosas would not sit still, and declared war on Brazil on 18 August, which opened the war in earnest. The conflict took its name from the plata, the silver, of the Río de la Plata: Spanish Guerra Platina, Portuguese Guerra do Prata, Chinese 鉑金戰爭. The same place-name was used again for the Argentine and Brazilian arbitration crisis of 1906 to 1909.
impact: 這一仗把拉普拉塔地區的權力版圖整個翻轉。羅薩斯流亡，恩特雷里歐斯系接掌阿根廷：翌年五月三十一日十四省代表在聖尼古拉斯達成協議，一八五三年召開制憲會議，訂出阿根廷一八五三年憲法，阿根廷邦聯以烏爾基薩為首任總裁重建。但布宜諾斯艾利斯省不願接受這份協議，於一八五二年九月宣布脫離邦聯，聯邦與布宜諾斯艾利斯州又打了近十年內戰，直到一八六一年帕翁一役才分勝負，米特雷在次年當選統一後的總統。巴西則鞏固了對拉普拉塔地區的霸主地位，烏拉圭與巴拉圭的獨立得到承認，巴拉圭取得出入河道的自由，重建舊拉普拉塔總督區的想法再無可能。技術層面上，這是滑膛野戰砲最後一次大規模上陣：卡塞羅斯中央的砲兵對射，比的仍是火藥裝量、砲口初速與射距，而不是膛線帶來的精度；同一時期在歐洲定型的線膛野戰砲即將在射程上蓋過滑膛，下一場大規模砲戰的規則會因此改寫。海軍的作用同樣被記錄下來：一支蒸汽艦隊封住河口、突破上游水道，就足以決定一個內陸國家內戰的歸屬，這種局面在後來的南美戰爭中一再重演。
impactEn: The war turned the whole political map of the Platine region over. Rosas was in exile and the Entre Ríos faction took over Argentina: on 31 May of the following year representatives of fourteen provinces reached the San Nicolás Agreement, a constituent congress met in 1853, the Argentine Constitution of 1853 was drawn up, and the Argentine Confederation was rebuilt with Urquiza as its first director. But the province of Buenos Aires would not accept that agreement, seceded from the Confederation in September 1852, and the Confederation and the state of Buenos Aires fought another civil war of nearly ten years, settled only by the battle of Pavón in 1861, with Mitre elected president of the reunited country the year after. Brazil, for its part, confirmed its hegemony over the Platine region; the independence of Uruguay and Paraguay was secured, Paraguay gained free access to the rivers, and any thought of restoring the old Viceroyalty of the Plata became technically impossible. On the technical level this was the last great occasion on which smoothbore field guns fought in earnest: the duel of artillery in the centre at Caseros was still decided by the weight of charge, muzzle velocity and range rather than by the accuracy a rifled bore gave, and the rifled field gun settled in Europe at this very moment would soon outrange the smoothbore and rewrite the rules of the next large artillery engagement. The part played by the navy was likewise written into the record: a squadron of steamers that sealed the river mouth and broke through the upper channels was enough to decide the fate of a civil war in a country without a coastline, a situation that repeated itself in later South American wars.
result: 結局是聯軍的全勝。二月三日卡塞羅斯，羅薩斯的兩翼先崩，中央奇拉韋特的砲兵對射在彈藥耗盡後告終，羅薩斯喬裝水手離開戰場，經英國公使安排，於二月五日乘英國船「半人馬座號」離港流亡；官方報告聯軍陣亡受傷六百人，羅薩斯方一千四百人死傷、七千人被俘。聯軍在二月五日派三個營進城維持秩序，二月十八日烏爾基薩騎著羅薩斯的馬入城，接掌布宜諾斯艾利斯總督職；巴西軍隊則選在二月二十日、即二十五年前伊圖薩因戈之敗的同一天，在布宜諾斯艾利斯街頭遊行慶功。同一期間被圍困的布宜諾斯艾利斯城也在二月十一日陷落，一般記載其圍城自十一月底起、共七十九日，阿爾西納重傷不治，伊里戈延與家人自盡。戰爭以聯軍的勝利收場：羅薩斯的統治瓦解，恩特雷里奧斯系取得阿根廷的領導權，巴西坐穩拉普拉塔地區的霸主地位，烏拉圭與巴拉圭各得其所。留下的卻是新的分裂：布宜諾斯艾利斯脫離邦聯，國家統一的問題要再打十年才有着落；這場戰爭也成為滑膛野戰砲與騎兵主導的最後一場大規模戰役，砲兵下一次改寫戰局，要等到膛線與新式火藥真正結合之後。
resultEn: The result was a complete allied victory. At Caseros on 3 February the Rosista flanks broke first, and the duel of Chilavert's guns in the centre ended when the ammunition ran out; Rosas left the field disguised as a sailor and, through arrangements made by the British consul, left the port on the British ship Centaur on 5 February for exile. The official report gives 600 dead and wounded among the allies and 1,400 killed or wounded with 7,000 captured on the Rosista side. On 5 February the allies sent three battalions into the city to keep order, and on 18 February Urquiza entered Buenos Aires on Rosas's own horse and took up the governorship of the city; the Brazilian army marked the victory with a parade through the streets of Buenos Aires on 20 February, deliberately on the twenty-fifth anniversary of the defeat at Ituzaingó. The city of Buenos Aires, which had been under siege throughout, fell on 11 February; the siege is generally recorded as running from late November for seventy-nine days, and Alsina died of his wounds while Irigoyen took his own life together with his family. The war ended in an allied victory: Rosas's rule collapsed, the Entre Ríos faction took the leadership of Argentina, Brazil settled into hegemony over the Platine region, and Uruguay and Paraguay each gained what they had fought for. What remained was a new division: Buenos Aires left the Confederation and the question of national unity would take another ten years of fighting to settle. This was also the last great battle fought under the command of smoothbore field guns and cavalry; the artillery would next rewrite the battle only once the rifled bore and the new propellants had truly been combined.
